Summarize a Calendar

Source: R/calendar-class.R
summary.Calendar.Rd

Complements print() with the quantitative view: coverage of a sampled calendar, share/weight statistics, and the catalog classification when present. Returns a "summary_Calendar" object (a list) with its own print method — the mirror of summary.Geoscale() in geoscales.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'Calendar'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class '`timescales::Calendar`'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary_Calendar'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

object

A Calendar.

...

Ignored.

x

A "summary_Calendar" object (the print method's argument).

Value

summary() returns a list of class "summary_Calendar": name, desc, timeframes (named member counts), n_timeslices, year_fraction, coverage (see calendar_coverage()), sampled, parent_name, coverage_class/regularity (catalog designs only), share_range, weight_range, year_start, utc_offset_minutes.

Examples

summary(calendar("m12_h24"))
#> <summary of Calendar 'm12_h24' >
#>   timeframes:     MONTH (12) / HOUR (24)
#>   timeslices:     288
#>   year_fraction:  1
#>   catalog:        complete, regular
#>   share range:    0.003196 .. 0.003539
#>   weight range:   28 .. 31
#>   year_start:     month=1, day=1
#>   utc offset:     0 min
summary(filter_calendar(calendar("s4_h24"), "SEASON", "WIN"))
#> <summary of Calendar 's4_h24[SEASON:WIN]' >
#>   timeframes:     SEASON (1) / HOUR (24)
#>   timeslices:     24
#>   year_fraction:  0.246575
#>   SAMPLED:        share 24.7%, weight 24.7% of 's4_h24'
#>   catalog:        representative, regular
#>   share range:    0.01027 .. 0.01027
#>   weight range:   90 .. 90
#>   year_start:     month=1, day=1
#>   utc offset:     0 min
